identity.question: Will Flavio Bolsonaro win the most votes in the second round of the Brazil presidential election from Amazonas?

scope: Frozen predicate is Flávio highest valid votes in presidential Amazonas runoff, not governor. Same PoderData PDF has both contests; only its presidential pages apply.

TSE_first_round.result: Lula 1,046,996 (48.23%); Flávio Nantes Bolsonaro 976,764 (45.00%), first round only; report caveats appeal modifications.

Quaest.gap: Article body gives no survey mode.

PoderData.source: Original survey PDF linked by Poder360 report
PoderData.method: Telephone IVR/random dialer; weighted by sex, age, education, income
PoderData.rounding: PDF warns rounded results can sum other than 100; figures sum 101.

access.note: HTML blocked; linked original survey PDF captured successfully as above.

coverage.finding: Bounded public search found these two state-level presidential runoff polls, with last field dates through Oct12; no later Amazonas presidential fieldwork verified. This is not an exhaustive PesqEle absence check. Election scheduled Oct25; no runoff result yet.
coverage.dependence: Distinct pollsters/samples, overlapping dates/geography; intentions include blank/undecided, not valid-vote estimates or official tally.
coverage.governor: PoderData PDF separately reports governor race Omar Aziz 52 / Maria do Carmo 42, blank 4 / undecided 2; unrelated to case462.

limits: Facts only; no forecast, ranking, rejection, ledger or trade.
